data.description:
Gravity Sketch is the immersive 3D design tool that empowers you to create, share and collaborate on your best design ideas. Go beyond the bounds of 2D sketching to express yourself in a virtual studio and explore iterations of designs. Communicate design intent with greater clarity, and invite others to help shape your ideas and decision-making.

Key Features:

Intuitive 3D expression: Express your ideas at 1:1 scale in a virtual studio, just as you imagined them. Gestural actions and simple tools open up infinite possibilities.

Refinement tooling: Take sketches further with surfacing and sculpting tools. Adjust shapes, proportions, textures, and lighting to capture the right details you need to communicate your idea.

Collaboration: Invite colleagues, friends, or clients to join your virtual space in-headset or on screen to work together in real-time. Make faster decisions together on design direction, reducing your product’s time to market by 70+%.

Organization and storage: Access an extensive library of ready-to-use 3D assets, including models, materials, and environments. Import and export your own creations, incorporate them into workflows effortlessly via LandingPad.

Community: Join a passionate community of designers. Explore comprehensive tutorials, learn from experts, and get inspired by others’ Gravity Sketch projects.

Help email: support@gravitysketch.com 
General inquiries: hello@gravitysketch.com
To unlock our enterprise capabilities please contact us

changelog.change_log:
Gravity Sketch 6.4 is centered around the presentation of ideas in Gravity Sketch – facilitating better representation and exploration of design intent.

Applying color texture and materials to your designs in VR can be achieved with greater ease: You can get hands on with texture manipulation with intuitive scaling and rotation, plus the ability to pan.

Materials now have additional properties that can be manipulated including roughness, metallic values, outline thickness and clear coat application. These controls can help improve the realism of designs.

6.4 also brings a set of improvements to enhance the experience of joining rooms from your PC: an updated UI makes navigation simple, and presenters can keep their flow as comments are now decoupled from viewpoints. New functionality includes the ability to import, select and move objects in a room, alongside a share button from inside Screen Collab – making it easier to bring others in to collaborate.

🚀 Features & Improvements

- Thickened surfaces can now be baked with either hard edges (creased) or soft edges
- Better visual feedback for touching vs. pressing buttons
- Web browser experimental feature: enabled uploading instant screenshots and downloading 3D files (useful for AI workflows). This is a beta feature so this may not work consistently/not work for all web pages.

🐛 Bug Fixes
- Duplicating a collapsed layer group now correctly duplicates the layers it contains
- Fixed memory issues when repeatedly deleting/restoring points
- Other misc fixes

🚀 Features & Improvements

- Added “Bake Transforms” option to FBX exports, which solves some transform issues when opening an exported file in Rhino and avoids the creation of empties in Blender
- Some performance improvements when importing large zipped files (GRS, OBJ)

🐛 Bug Fixes

- Standalone headsets: local folders now visible in import menu when “Allow USB File Access” is disabled
- Recovery autosaves now have the correct layer/layer group info
- Viewpoint navigation via thumbstick now respects viewpoint order
- Cancelling a save no longer causes bad filepaths to be displayed on next save attempt
- Progress bar numbers when uploading larger files now make more sense
- Fixed wrong hues on screenshots of the web browser
- When creating primitive shapes in Central Line mode, shift trigger can now be used to create shapes with uniform dimensions e.g. a perfect sphere/cube
- Fixed some UI options incorrectly displaying in Collab for users who don’t have access to them

🐛 Bug Fixes

- Fixed memory issues when repeatedly deleting/restoring points
- Other misc fixes

🚀 Features & Improvements

- Improved Quick Access inside menu: this now includes Export, Share, Save, Screenshot, Exit and Help buttons.
- Added an outside panel to Quick Access menu (access this by rotating the non-drawing hand inwards, as though looking at a wristwatch). This now gives quick access to the following buttons: Find My Sketch, Vertical Lock, Mirror, Home Orientation, Grid and Layers.
- Updated the UI for several sketch menu buttons.
- The Grid option has been moved from the beta panel to the main Sketching Aid menu.
- Self-onboarding rooms in the Learn tab now remain accessible when not logged into LandingPad.

🐛 Bug Fixes

- Fixed extra edge duplications when using smart move on SubD edges.
- Improved positioning of rigged models on export.
- Restored virtual headset highlight on passthrough gesture.
- Fixed failure on converting a template sketch into a Collab room twice in the same session.
- Fixed UI overlap when toggling planar mode on a group edit.
- Fixed some memory issues caused by thickened surfaces.
- FBX exports now communicate creases properly when opened in Blender 4.2.
